summary: Show human names in thread drafts and Inbox references instead of graph identifiers

schema.detail: No storage or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Thread delivery and consistency rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Thread drafts use the existing sender display names, raised-by rows omit agent identifiers, and Inbox step references show the human title or plain words rather than generated mission identifiers.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal binary restart.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back requires no data migration.
